items.t: Ukraine's attack partly collapses Crimean Bridge
items.d: A weeks-planned missile and drone strike badly damaged Russia's prized bridge to annexed Crimea, which Zelensky called unprecedented. It hits a key supply route and a major symbol of the occupation.

items.t: Trump in Asia for talks with Xi and Putin at APEC
items.d: Trump arrived for the APEC summit in Shenzhen, where a rare US–China–Russia leaders' meeting is planned. Xi met Putin today, and Trump said he is open to a one-on-one with Putin.

items.t: Nvidia posts bumper results but won't bring back Huang
items.d: Quarterly revenue more than doubled to about $116bn, beating forecasts. But the board ruled out reinstating ousted CEO Jensen Huang, despite Trump backing a campaign to return him.

items.t: Russian military plane crash kills all 19 aboard
items.d: The aircraft came down in Siberia's Kemerovo region. Russia's defence ministry blamed a likely technical fault.

items.t: Trump takes alleged Iranian plot 'very seriously'
items.d: Trump said the US is treating reports of an Iranian plan against Washington seriously. Tehran called claims of a 'dirty bomb' plot baseless.

items.t: Five EU countries plan migrant return hub in Rwanda
items.d: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands will send failed asylum seekers to a centre in Rwanda, a sign of Europe's tougher line on migration.

items.t: Democrats edge ahead in Alaska Senate race
items.d: Democrat Mary Peltola leads Republican Senator Dan Sullivan as counting continues, a rare pickup chance in a state Trump won easily.

items.t: Anthropic IPO set to price at top of range or above
items.d: The Claude maker told investors its listing should price at or above $70–78 a share, after heavy demand. Amazon and Google will together own about 28% after the IPO.

items.t: US tightens chip curbs on South East Asia
items.d: New rules restrict advanced chip exports and rented computing power in the region, closing a route Chinese firms used to reach AI hardware.

items.t: Canada's Carney looks to China as US tariffs bite
items.d: With Trump's tariffs squeezing Canada's car industry, Carney suggested Chinese carmakers could replace American ones, though experts say it would be hard.

items.t: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models
items.d: The new models arrive in ChatGPT, Codex and the API, with Astra about 20% cheaper than its predecessor, keeping pressure on rivals.

items.t: Microsoft unveils six in-house AI models
items.d: At Ignite, Microsoft showed models for coding, security, images and voice, pricing its MAI Code 2 well below rivals as it relies less on OpenAI.

items.t: Apple and Microsoft hit by big service outages
items.d: iCloud, the App Store and Apple Music went down after an internal update, while Microsoft 365 email also failed. US officials say recent outages are not cyberattacks.

items.t: California bans Waymo robotaxis from freeways
items.d: After a viral video, regulators barred Waymo from freeways and the company paused freeway rides nationwide, a setback for robotaxi expansion.

items.t: Google to keep Gemini chats for two months
items.d: Even temporary chats and those with history off will now be stored for about two months instead of 72 hours, raising privacy questions.

items.t: Uber and Zipline start drone food deliveries in Texas
items.d: Autonomous drones now deliver Uber Eats orders in Spring, Texas, with dozens more US cities planned.

items.t: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years
items.d: More than 5,400 cases and 10 deaths this year mean measles is again spreading locally, a blow blamed on falling vaccination.

items.t: Big UK study to test social media ban on teens
items.d: Ten research teams will track how teenagers cope without social media, the largest British look at its effect on youth mental health.

items.t: Pakistan's rooftop solar boom outpaces its grid
items.d: Home panels lifted solar's share of Pakistan's power from 1% to 28%, leaving the national grid struggling to adapt.

items.t: Government backs welfare shake-up for young jobless
items.d: Alan Milburn's review proposes moving spending from benefits to job support to avoid a 'lost generation', and ministers have backed it.

items.t: Burnham to set out EU relationship options next month
items.d: The prime minister will present options for long-term ties with the EU alongside his 10-year economic plan.

items.t: US soldier held in UK spying probe handed to US military
items.d: The Met says an American soldier arrested on suspicion of espionage is now in US military custody.

items.t: 烏克蘭襲擊致克里米亞大橋部分倒塌
items.d: 經數星期策劃的導彈及無人機襲擊重創連接克里米亞的大橋，澤連斯基形容行動史無前例。大橋是俄軍重要補給線，亦是佔領的象徵。

items.t: 特朗普抵亞洲 將在APEC與習近平普京會談
items.d: 特朗普抵達深圳出席APEC峰會，美中俄三國元首罕有會晤在即。習近平今日已會見普京，特朗普表示對與普京單獨會面持開放態度。

items.t: Nvidia業績亮麗 但拒讓黃仁勳回朝
items.d: 季度收入倍增至約1,160億美元，勝預期。但董事會排除讓被撤職的行政總裁黃仁勳復職，儘管特朗普支持要求他回歸的運動。

items.t: 俄羅斯軍機墜毀 機上19人全部罹難
items.d: 軍機在西伯利亞克麥羅沃州墜毀。俄羅斯國防部初步認為是技術故障所致。

items.t: 特朗普稱「非常認真」看待伊朗陰謀指控
items.d: 特朗普表示美國認真看待伊朗圖謀襲擊華盛頓的報道。德黑蘭斥所謂「髒彈」襲擊陰謀的說法毫無根據。

items.t: 五個歐盟國家擬在盧旺達設遣返中心
items.d: 德國、丹麥、奧地利、希臘及荷蘭將把尋求庇護失敗者送往盧旺達的「遣返中心」，反映歐洲收緊移民政策。

items.t: 阿拉斯加參議院選舉 民主黨領先
items.d: 點票仍在進行，民主黨的佩爾托拉領先共和黨參議員蘇利文，民主黨有望在特朗普大勝的州份罕有奪席。

items.t: Anthropic招股料以上限或以上定價
items.d: Claude開發商Anthropic因認購踴躍，向投資者表示定價料達每股70至78美元上限或以上。上市後Amazon及Google合共持股約28%。

items.t: 美國收緊對東南亞晶片出口限制
items.d: 新規限制向東南亞出口先進晶片及租用算力，堵塞中國企業借道取得AI硬件的途徑。

items.t: 加拿大總理卡尼因美國關稅轉向中國
items.d: 特朗普關稅打擊加拿大汽車業，卡尼暗示中國車廠可取代美國車廠，但有專家認為並不容易。

items.t: OpenAI推出GPT-6.2 Astra及Sol模型
items.d: 新模型登陸ChatGPT、Codex及API，Astra價格較上一代便宜約兩成，加劇與對手競爭。

items.t: Microsoft發布六款自家AI模型
items.d: Microsoft在Ignite大會展示涵蓋編程、保安、圖像及語音的模型，MAI Code 2定價遠低於對手，減少依賴OpenAI。

items.t: Apple及Microsoft服務大規模故障
items.d: Apple因內部更新導致iCloud、App Store及Apple Music故障，Microsoft 365電郵亦癱瘓。美國官員表示近期故障並非網絡攻擊。

items.t: 加州禁Waymo無人的士行駛高速公路
items.d: 一段網上瘋傳的影片後，監管機構禁止Waymo上高速公路，公司亦暫停全美高速公路服務，令無人的士擴張受挫。

items.t: Google將保留Gemini對話兩個月
items.d: 即使是臨時對話或已關閉記錄的對話，保存期亦由72小時延長至約兩個月，引起私隱關注。

items.t: Uber與Zipline在德州推無人機送餐
items.d: 自動駕駛無人機開始在德州斯普林為Uber Eats送餐，並計劃擴展至美國數十個城市。

items.t: 美國失去消除麻疹地位 為26年來首次
items.d: 今年錄得逾5,400宗病例及10人死亡，麻疹再次在本地傳播，被歸咎於疫苗接種率下降。

items.t: 英國大型研究評估禁社交媒體對青少年影響
items.d: 十個研究團隊將追蹤青少年在沒有社交媒體下的情況，是英國規模最大的相關精神健康研究。

items.t: 巴基斯坦屋頂太陽能熱潮跑贏電網
items.d: 家用太陽能板令巴基斯坦太陽能發電比例由1%升至28%，國家電網難以追上。

items.t: 政府支持福利改革 助年輕失業者
items.d: 前部長米爾本的檢討建議將福利開支轉投就業支援，以免出現「失落的一代」，政府表示支持。

items.t: 賓咸下月提出與歐盟長遠關係方案
items.d: 首相賓咸將在公布十年經濟計劃的同時，提出與歐盟長遠關係的選項。

items.t: 英國涉間諜案美軍士兵交美軍羈押
items.d: 倫敦警察廳表示，一名涉嫌間諜活動被捕的美國士兵已交由美軍羈押。
